top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure Onto Other Parts (26 TAC §746.4603(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained, a child was playing on monkey bars during outdoor play which resulted into an injury.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have a current health inspection for licensing to view.

top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current gas inspection on file.
